But the proposal cannot be applied as written. (1) Its report requires removing seven existing atlas edges, among them HQ.4 -> HQ.3. PROTOCOL §15 has no removal field and scripts/restructure.py never removes edges, so the proposed link HQ.3 -> HQ.4 is skipped as a cycle and the new HQ.3/HQ.4 split (HQ.3 owns the descent theorem that HQ.4 applies and compares with) cannot be represented. (2) 65 supplier -> consumer links required by §15 for the eleven narrowed layers are missing. (3) HQ.1, HQ.4, HR.1, HR.2 and HR.4 hand theory to the draft roadmaps QWittVectors and SolidAnalyticRings, which are not yet in the atlas, so their 26 links are skipped and those targets would have no atlas owner until the drafts are accepted.
